_note: Site names, coordinates and descriptive context are real (descriptions follow the project proposal). ALL MEASUREMENT VALUES ARE SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION VALUES chosen to exercise the interface. They are not derived from any dataset and must not be cited. These are research candidates, not validated analogs.

candidates.name: Atacama Desert
candidates.description: One of the driest non-polar places on Earth, with rocky, salt-encrusted plains and very little vegetation.
candidates.potential_comparison: Selected arid and rocky Martian environments
candidates.caution: Aridity does not reproduce Mars's atmosphere, radiation or temperature.
candidates.data_quality: SRTM covers the site. No sub-metre imagery is connected, so rock cover cannot be measured.

candidates.name: Death Valley
candidates.description: Deep desert basin with salt pans, alluvial fans, dunes and steep surrounding ranges.
candidates.caution: Terrain varies strongly across the region; results depend on the exact analysis window.
candidates.data_quality: SRTM covers the site. No sub-metre imagery is connected.

candidates.name: Meteor Crater
candidates.description: Well-preserved simple impact crater about 1.2 km across on the Colorado Plateau.
candidates.potential_comparison: Impact-crater landforms on the Moon and Mars
candidates.caution: A terrestrial impact structure has a different erosion and geological history.
candidates.data_quality: SRTM covers the site. The crater is resolved by a 30 m DEM; rocks are not.

candidates.name: Hawaiian volcanic fields
candidates.description: Basaltic lava flows, cinder cones and tephra on the upper slopes of Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa.
candidates.caution: Basalt alone does not establish full material equivalence.
candidates.data_quality: SRTM covers the site. No sub-metre imagery is connected.

candidates.name: Icelandic volcanic landscapes
candidates.description: Young lava fields and volcanic sand plains in the highlands north of Vatnajökull.
candidates.caution: Weather, vegetation, ice and seasonal conditions differ markedly.
candidates.data_quality: Outside SRTM coverage (above 60°N); ASTER GDEM planned instead. Geological indicator not yet assigned.
